questions.question: When the LORD saw that Jacob's wife Leah was unloved, what did He do for her?

answers.text: He gave her flocks of her own
He sent her back to her father

questions.question: When Jacob's wife Rachel saw she was not having children, what did she say to Jacob?

answers.text: Give me children or I will die
Pray to the LORD for me

questions.question: When Jacob's wife Leah gave birth to her fourth son, Judah, what did she say?

answers.text: This time I will praise the LORD
This time I will ask for a daughter
This time I will go home to my father

questions.question: Why did Jacob's wife Rachel tell him to take her maidservant Bilhah as a wife?

answers.text: So Bilhah can bear children for her
So Bilhah can serve Leah instead
So Bilhah can care for the flocks
